name: Atomic intrinsics battery
description: Every one of 16384 threads calls the same eleven global-memory atomic RMW intrinsics on the same 11-element output array, with no coordination beyond the atomics.
output_description: CUDA executable writes numeric output to output/cuda_output.txt.

performance.notes: Runtime logs are written by tools/benchmark_case.py.

extraction_notes: testKernel reproduced verbatim from NVIDIA/cuda-samples simpleAtomicIntrinsics_kernel.cuh. The host driver, CMakeLists, and Python oracle (tests/verify.py) are new; the CPU reference formulas mirror the sample's own computeGold (simpleAtomicIntrinsics_cpu.cpp). Snapshot sk-01.
notes: Real-extraction case from collection snapshot sk-01. len = numThreads*numBlocks = 16384. Nine order-independent slots (add/sub/max/min/inc/dec/and/or/xor) are checked exactly; atomicExch and atomicCAS are execution-order dependent and only range-checked to a valid thread id in [0, len).
